explanation: This method is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because .format(event_id) interpolates event_id directly into the DELETE query. An attacker supplying crafted input as event_id could alter the WHERE condition and delete unintended rows from the events table. The repair replaces string formatting with a %s placeholder and passes (event_id,) as a parameter tuple to self.cur.execute(), separating SQL syntax from data.
